en.disclaimer: Educational harm-reduction contextualizer for female androgen exposure. Not a prescription, dosing protocol, or medical endorsement of anabolic substances. Exogenous androgens carry high risks of irreversible virilization (vocal deepening, clitoromegaly, androgenic alopecia) in females.
